answer: Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 208 aliases means carrying 38 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. The nebula escrow is released only against a lantern receipt, and the quill audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 20 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 27 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
